newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA'S ADELAIDE CASINO AND ENVIRONS FOR SALE.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA'S ADELAIDE CASINO AND ENVIRONS FOR SALE.

text.p: The Adelaide casino complex, which includes the Hyatt hotel and Riverside office block is up for sale, with calls for expressions of interest advertised on Thursday, the South Australian government said.

State treasurer Stephen Baker said the formal sale process followed approval by the joint owners, the South Australian government and Japanese construction group Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd, to sell the package of assets which form part of the Adelaide Station Environs Redevelopment (ASER).
Baker said in a statement the ASER assets had undergone a comprehensive restructure to facilitate the sale of the casino, hotel and office building as individual assets or as a package.
Baker's spokeswoman told Reuters the joint partners would prefer the assets to be sold as a package.

"As a joint owner, the South Australian government expects considerable interest from throughout Australia and overseas," Baker said, adding expressions of interest would be circulated in national and international hotel and tourism markets.

Once the first round bids had been received a committee would prepare a short-list of parties who would be invited to submit final bids, all of which would be subject to strict probity assessment by the Gaming Supervisory Authority, he said.
The joint owners were aiming to finalise the selection of a preferred purchaser by the end of the year, he said.
